observations.inspection: Meadow witch at golden hour with a black cat and a wooden staff: the koukouya adapter is unmistakable (loose painterly brush, patched cloak, loose strokes in the grass and flowers), face and hands clean, the cat reads well; this is the closest match yet to the owner's target image 142028671.

Only the two detected crops changed. The raised hand is now a clean five-digit hand with readable joints and a proper thumb; the face pass opened and sharpened the eye (teal iris, cleaner lashes) while keeping the profile and hair - at denoise 0.4 the expression shifts slightly, so use the Gentle variant when only hands need work.

Base v1.0 look still unproven.
